description: Open-source GraphRAG domain knowledge layer: LLMs continuously distill scattered skill docs into a queryable, evolvable, human-editable two-layer knowledge graph — versioned, hot-swapped and rolled back via a GitOps pipeline like software releases, and served to AI agents over MCP. RAG, but with relational structure.
